Maria: Quick check — PR #19731 touches the users table (one small column add + backfill). Can we get a merge slot before the nightly deploy-freeze? Preferably the rebase window tonight so we don’t block the pipeline. @Aj @Kevin any blockers from infra/DB side?
Aj: I can carve out a rebase window but CI has been flaking on the mac matrix recently. Can we trigger a targeted rerun first? :eyes:
Sam: I can kick off the rerun. How long do you expect the canary to run? Does this need any downtime or a migration lock?
Maria: No downtime expected. We do need a short migration lock (~2m) during the rolling step. Canary should be ~15m (smoke + integration). Plan: 1) targeted CI rerun 2) canary with DB team watching 3) merge during the 23:00-00:00 UTC rebase window.
Kevin: DB team note — for schema changes we ask for 24h notice for big migrations, but this is small. I can sign off on a canary if infra is ready and we have a rollback plan. Please attach rollback SQL in the PR.
Maria: Will add rollback SQL to the PR now and flip a feature flag. @ci-bot can you run: `./scripts/ci-trigger --pr 19731 --matrices linux,mac,windows`?
ci-bot: Rerun queued for PR 19731 — matrices: linux, mac, windows. Jobs: 12. ETA ~8m.
Aj: Thanks — pinged the rebase window owner, we still have the 23:00-00:00 UTC slot. No deploy freeze starts until 00:00 UTC.
Sam: Reruns: linux ✅, windows ✅, mac flaky on first try but passed on retry (logs: `build/test-mac #3`). Leaving the integration run running now.
Maria: Sounds good. @Kevin do you want to start the canary now? I'll hold the merge until you confirm.
Kevin: Starting canary on canary-1. Monitor: `canary.ci.redwood` — running smoke and DB checks. Will update in ~10m.
Kevin: Canary passed basic checks, ran the rollback test locally too. DB team +1 for proceeding. Added a short note in the PR about the rollback SQL.
Aj: Merge checklist done: bumped migration version, added feature flag, updated runbook link in PR description. If DB +1, I can land during the rebase window with `gh pr merge --squash --admin` and follow the post-deploy smoke.
Maria: Thanks all — no objections here. Proceed when ready. :tada:
Aj: Merged at 1743211180. Post-deploy smoke all green. Noted in #releases log.
Maria: Awesome, thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
release-bot: Reminder — deploy-freeze starts 2025-11-15T00:00Z. All merges after this time will be blocked unless explicitly allowed by release squad.
